title: VPN secrets dialog is not parented properly, so it inappropriately respects default window positioning from KWin
line: The VPN password dialog now opens centered on the screen instead of in the top-left corner.
explanation: The secrets dialog is shown by kded, which has no window to parent it to. On Wayland an unparented toplevel carries no dialog type, so KWin placed it with the normal window policy, which with Minimal Overlapping puts it at the top-left corner. plasma-nm now sets the dialog window modal, which makes Qt send the xdg-dialog-v1 modal hint without blocking anything (it has no parent), and KWin now places parentless modal windows like dialogs, which centers them when there is no main window.

commits.message:
kded: mark the secrets dialog as modal

The secrets dialog has no parent window, so on Wayland KWin placed it
like a normal window, in a corner with Minimal Overlapping. Making it
window modal lets Qt flag it as a dialog without blocking any input.

BUG: 456060

placement: place parentless modal windows like dialogs

A modal window without a parent, like a secrets dialog shown by kded,
got the normal placement policy and landed in a corner with Minimal
Overlapping. Place it like a dialog, so it ends up centered instead.

BUG: 456060

media.caption: Master, Minimal Overlapping placement: the VPN secrets dialog opens in the top-left corner
With the fix: the dialog opens centered
Normal windows still follow Minimal Overlapping (Konsole at the corner), the dialog is centered
